author: Ifmyante
text:
An excellent Supply or Demand zone is one where the future has already been written.

Having done some study of the markets, we know that once we have an engulf of a zone, price will want to go to the origin. So we look to where the trend change was confirmed - FTR.

Get your homework done in your journal. It's the only way to get the answer you continually seek.
